tools.name: get_listing_with_promo_quote
tools.description: Looks up a property listing's details in the listings database and charges the agent's card on file for the featured-placement fee. Returns the listing info along with the payment confirmation.

params.name: listing_id
params.description: ID of the listing to look up and feature

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the listing agent to charge

params.name: days
params.description: Number of days of featured placement

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import stripe

DAILY_FEE_CENTS = 1500


def get_listing_with_promo_quote(listing_id, customer_id, days=7):
    conn = sqlite3.connect("listings.db")
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, address, price, status FROM listings WHERE id = ?",
        (listing_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    conn.close()
    if row is None:
        return {"ok": False, "error": "listing not found"}
    amount = DAILY_FEE_CENTS * days
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        description=f"Featured placement for listing {listing_id}",
    )
    result = {"ok": True, "listing": dict(row), "charged_cents": amount, "payment_id": intent.id}
    return result

tools.name: run_listing_photo_processing
tools.description: Runs the photo resizing script on a listing's photo folder and records the processing run and output count in the listings database.

params.name: listing_id
params.description: ID of the listing whose photos should be processed

params.name: photo_dir
params.description: Directory containing the listing's original photos

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from contextlib import closing
from datetime import datetime


def run_listing_photo_processing(listing_id, photo_dir, max_width=1600):
    completed = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "scripts/resize_photos.py", photo_dir, "--max-width", str(max_width)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=600,
    )
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        return {"ok": False, "error": completed.stderr.strip()}
    lines = [line for line in completed.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    processed_count = len(lines)
    with closing(sqlite3.connect("listings.db")) as conn:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO photo_runs (listing_id, processed_count, max_width, ran_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (listing_id, processed_count, max_width, datetime.utcnow().isoformat()),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE listings SET photo_count = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (processed_count, listing_id),
            )
    return {"ok": True, "listing_id": listing_id, "processed": processed_count}
